review.tagline: LLM pull request reviewer that comments via /review, /describe and /improve
review.summary: PR-Agent runs as a GitHub Action, CLI, Docker image or webhook service and posts AI-generated descriptions, reviews, code suggestions and Q&A on pull requests. Each tool makes a single LLM call, and a compression strategy handles large diffs. It supports GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps and Gitea, and any model reachable through LiteLLM.
review.audience: Teams wanting self-hosted AI pull request review in CI or on their git host
strengths: Supports GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps and Gitea
Model-agnostic via LiteLLM: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Bedrock, Ollama and others
One LLM call per tool, about 30 seconds per command
Review behavior is configurable through a TOML settings file and JSON prompts
weaknesses: Described as a community-maintained legacy project of Qodo
/help_docs is disabled since v0.36.1 over a credential-exposure issue
Needs your own LLM API key and per-provider setup
Docker images moved to pragent/pr-agent from 0.34.2, so pinned references break
needs: Needs LLM API key (e.g. OpenAI), Git provider token
Models: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Mistral
